_meta.purpose: Where each sermon's audio lives. The app ships the PATHS, never the audio: 589 files and 4.88 GB of it are already public on the church's own site, and mirroring them would be four and a half gigabytes of hosting to serve files that are already served.
_meta.baseIsADefault: The host is overridable at build time with --dart-define=SERMON_AUDIO_BASE=... so that moving to a mirror is a rebuild rather than a rewrite of this file.
_meta.verified: All 589 URLs returned HTTP 200 with Content-Type audio/mpeg and Accept-Ranges: bytes on 2026-09-02, and two real ranged requests came back 206 including a mid-file seek, so a listener can scrub. Every Last-Modified falls inside one 18-minute window on 2022-01-09.
_meta.cors: The host sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin. A media element is not subject to CORS unless it sets crossOrigin, so playback works; fetch()/XHR against these URLs does NOT, which is why web cannot add audio to the offline pack and native can.
_meta.parts: A sermon in several parts is several files, in the order given. `p` is the part letter as the church names it, `u` the path under `base`, `b` the size in bytes.
